crossReadings.why: NOT a preset defect. Harness 0.2.2-rc.1 removed the ./list-agents subpath export from dsh-tool-subagent-control, so the preset row had to go; 0.2.1-rc.5's standard preset still declares it. One preset cannot straddle two harness lines, and a row whose module no longer resolves cannot be kept (the loader resolves the module before honouring `disabled`). This is the wave's declared capability delta on the older host.
